certificate: PESO licence under Petroleum Rules 2002 (other than Form III/XVII)
validity: In force till 31 December of the last year granted/renewed; max 3 years
renewal: Renewable by licensing authority for 3 calendar years where no contravention
engine_behaviour: APPLIES if unit holds such a licence (input); VERIFIED_CONDITIONAL (post-2019 amendments not checked)

certificate: PESO licence Form E/F/G under Gas Cylinders Rules 2016
validity: In force till 30 September; max 10 years
engine_behaviour: APPLIES if licence held; amendments 386(E)/839(E)/315(E) read - none touch r.51/55; 2018/2019/2022/225(E)/501(E) not read

certificate: PESO licence LS-1A/LS-1B under SMPV(U) Rules 2016
validity: In force till 30 September; max 5 years
engine_behaviour: APPLIES if licence held; 2018/2019/2021 amendments not read

certificate: Renewal of Final Fire Safety Approval (MFS)
renewal: No renewal of final approval (Form B twice yearly is separate)
rule_reference: MFS circulars 30-10-2014, 31-01-2025; Fire Act s.3 proviso (2023)
engine_behaviour: DOES_NOT_APPLY (FR-01) unless another Act/Rule requires it (F-FIR-20)

certificate: MFS PA-7 claim: Petroleum Act / Gas Cylinder Rules demand fire renewal every year
renewal: NOT_FOUND in Petroleum Rules 2002, GCR 2016, SMPV 2016 texts read (licence periods are up to 3/10/5 years; no provision requiring an MFS fire-approval renewal located)
engine_behaviour: F-FIR-20 stays UNKNOWN unless a rule is cited; PESO licence renewal (SSC-01..03) is NOT an MFS fire renewal
